tiles.title: Count of errors by legal entity

queries.text:
let invoiceBatchJobs = (){ 
    customEvents
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where name == "BatchTaskStart"
    | extend ClassName = tostring(customDimensions.ClassName)
    | where ClassName == "SalesFormLetter_Invoice"
    | extend BatchJobId = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobId)
    | extend BatchJobMainCaption = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobCaption)
    | where BatchJobMainCaption != "<empty>"
    | summarize arg_min(timestamp, BatchJobMainCaption) by  BatchJobId
};
let environments=datatable(Id:string,environmentName:string)[
    "4de0aba8-4f99-410a-bdb1-09c38819af73","production",
    "1388cd9a-1e88-49c0-98be-edc64ee66f8e","production: dataverse",
    "f140fa56-589e-453e-874a-add45ff6da25", "uat-ew1",
    "f7a7ba7e-3e87-4984-a241-2eea6343b8a4","hyprcr1",
    "ba3739a3-6ca0-4e0b-b956-1c6bb3baae2a","uat-qaS1",
    "50492b6e-dcca-4e89-ae74-94d69978840e","dev-dqa1",
    "c0bae898-f50b-47a7-9279-9b374776b9f9","dev-dqa0",
    "6d882c2d-1512-443a-8903-dd47ccbc181f","tmp-migprp",
    "e77a7d25-57a1-4889-8392-77c991cfa50b","pre-prp",
    "706324c1-f6b7-4cfb-b642-078703e370d8","tmp-feature"
    ];
exceptions
| where     timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend    CustomDimensionsParsed = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend    EnvironmentId   = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.environmentId)
| where     EnvironmentId in (_environmentId) or isempty(_environmentId)
| extend    LegalEntity     = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.LegalEntity)
| where LegalEntity in (_legalEntity) or isempty( _legalEntity)
| extend    BatchJobId      = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.BatchJobId)
| extend    BatchJobCaption = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.BatchJobCaption)
| join kind=inner invoiceBatchJobs on BatchJobId
| extend    ExecutionMode   = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.ExecutionMode)
| extend    ActivityId      = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.activityId)
| extend    MethodName      = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.MethodName)
| extend    ClassName       = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.ClassName)
| extend    CallStack       = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.CallStack)
| where     ExecutionMode   == "Batch"
| where _excludeCreditLimitErrors == false or outerMessage !contains "Credit limit"
| lookup  kind=leftouter (environments) on $left.EnvironmentId == $right.Id
| extend EnvironmentName = iif(environmentName =="", EnvironmentId, environmentName) 
| project   TimeStamp = timestamp, ["Environment"]=EnvironmentName, LegalEntity, BatchJobId, ["Batch Job Description"]=BatchJobMainCaption, ["Error Message"] = outerMessage

let invoiceBatchJobs = (){ 
    customEvents
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)

    | extend BatchJobMainCaption = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobCaption)
    | distinct BatchJobId, BatchJobMainCaption

exceptions
| where     timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend    CustomDimensionsParsed = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend    EnvironmentId   = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.environmentId)
| where     EnvironmentId in (_environmentId) or isempty(_environmentId)
| extend    LegalEntity     = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.LegalEntity)
| where LegalEntity in (_legalEntity) or isempty( _legalEntity)
| extend    BatchJobId      = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.BatchJobId)
| extend    BatchJobCaption = tostring(CustomDimensionsParsed.BatchJobCaption)

| lookup  kind=leftouter (environments) on $left.EnvironmentId == $right.Id

| order by LegalEntity asc

let environmentList=(pageViews
| union exceptions
| union customEvents
| union customMetrics
| union traces
| where timestamp  between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where client_Type == "PC" // exclude CDS
| extend Dims = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend environmentId = tostring(Dims.environmentId)
| where environmentId != ""
| distinct environmentId);
environmentList
| lookup  kind=leftouter (environments) on $left.environmentId == $right.Id
| extend EnvironmentName = iif(environmentName =="", environmentId, environmentName) 
| project environmentId, EnvironmentName
| sort by EnvironmentName asc

exceptions
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity)
| where isnotempty(LegalEntity) 
| distinct LegalEntity
| order by LegalEntity asc
